description: This file defines the PolicySupervisorActor class, which manages PolicyPersistenceActor instances in an Akka actor system. It handles creation, supervision, restart strategies, and exception handling for policy persistence.

classes.name: PolicySupervisorActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that supervises PolicyPersistenceActor instances, handling their lifecycle, restart logic, and exception management.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for Actor system to instantiate PolicySupervisorActor with given pubSubMediator and snapshotAdapter.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the PolicyId from the actor's self path, decoding URL-encoded name.

methods.name: getPersistenceActorProps
methods.description: Provides Props for creating a PolicyPersistenceActor with specified entityId.

methods.name: getExponentialBackOffConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the exponential back-off configuration from the system's policy config.

methods.name: getShutdownBehaviour
methods.description: Defines shutdown behavior for the actor based on PolicyId.

methods.name: getUnavailableExceptionBuilder
methods.description: Builds a PolicyUnavailableException for the given PolicyId, or a dummy if null.
